text:
leah: Customer ran quickstart after SSO invite and got a 403 on the first API call. They said the UI shows them as a guest member, but the sample app made it look like onboarding succeeded. Confusing.

leah: Sanitized curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \ 
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_guest_xxx\" \ 
 -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \ 
 -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","input":"hello"}'
```

leah: Response body: 
```json
{"error":"forbidden","reason":"org.role_restriction","message":"workspace role \"guest\" does not permit API calls","help_url":"https://console.redwood.ai/help/onboarding/roles"}
```

dmitri: This is an SSO/invite product decision: invited guests are created with limited role by default. The console shows them in the members list but doesn't clearly state API access is blocked. Quickstart should surface that.

sam: SDK currently treats 403 as terminal but surfaces a generic forbidden error with no guidance. We should: 1) surface help_url in the SDK error object, 2) add a typed RoleRestrictionError when reason==org.role_restriction, and 3) quickstart preflight to check membership.role and show a clear banner with link and next steps.

devex-bot: Runbook entry: https://console.redwood.ai/onboarding-runbook#roles. Suggest owner: @sam for SDK changes, @dmitri for quickstart.

support_agent: Workaround we gave customer: workspace owner promote the user to developer or create a dev workspace. I filed TKT-8200 and attached logs. Owner promoted user and the quickstart call succeeded.

dmitri: Small UX ask: when a guest hits the quickstart page we can show an inline note \"Your account is a guest; API calls are disabled. Ask your workspace owner to change your role or use a dev workspace.\" Quick change to quickstart README and sample UI.

sam: I'll open PRs to: node SDK (PR #5832) add RoleRestrictionError + include help_url; python follow-up. Also a small test to ensure we don't lose help_url in error serialization. ETA 48h.

leah: Thanks 44d Customer unblocked after role change. Leaving doc update request and adding a short troubleshooting blurb under \"first successful call\" about SSO guest roles.

devex-bot: Tagged @sdk-team @quickstart @support. Closing thread.
